notes:
What's new in 0.1.75:
• Parental controls now cover audiobooks, podcasts and internet radio. A limited profile can no longer see or play them unless the owner turns them on for that profile (Settings > Users). Profiles that were already limited lose them until you switch them on.
• An audiobook file that cannot be read is now left out of the library instead of showing up as an empty book (it is never deleted or moved), and the owner can see which files were skipped.
• A podcast feed that is cut off or has no episodes now gives a clear error instead of an empty show; an existing show keeps its episodes.
